entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
This video introduces the New Zealand Investment Story, created for government agencies and New Zealand businesses looking to attract international investment. 

New Zealand offers a stable, transparent and globally connected environment for investors. With a strong economy, trusted institutions, and an innovative business culture, New Zealand is an ideal place to grow and create long‑term value.
